name: rules-rtdb-r42-custom-token-standard-claims
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r42-custom-token-standard-claims" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). rules reading standard ID-token fields on auth.token (sub, iat, exp, iss, aud, auth_time, user_id, firebase.identities, firebase.sign_in_provider) must see the same non-null values in the simulator and sandbox that production exposes.
